node: Private-label and value-tier consumer staples contract manufacturing
summary: Expanded the public-company universe for the private-label/value-tier staples manufacturing node. TreeHouse Foods would have been the cleanest public reference name, but it was taken private by Investindustrial on February 11, 2026, creating a public-market coverage gap. The remaining US-listed universe is therefore more fragmented: large retailer customers such as Walmart anchor demand, while underfollowed small/mid-cap manufacturers with private-brand, contract-manufacturing, retailer qualification, food-safety, and customer-concentration exposure include Seneca Foods, John B. Sanfilippo & Son, and Mama's Creations. These are research candidates only, not recommendations.
